item.title: saltLight 0.2.0
item.description:
• A new left side: what plays now, then the queue. Press ▶ to play a scene, Next for the next one, and choose how long the crossfade takes.
  • New scene at the bottom left; Reset and Save at the bottom right. saltLight names each scene for you.
  • The scene panel on the right rests until you pick a scene in the queue, or make a new one.
  • Two sites: ASOP and AJ's Kitchen. Open the pill at the top right to switch. Each site has its own queue and its own Bridge.
  • Live plays what plays now on the site you are on. In AJ's Kitchen it streams to the kitchen strip, and the four ceiling spots follow its brightness and warmth.
  • The window fits a smaller screen too, down to an iPad's width.
